title: Engineers report: fixes for the minor findings of review-t002-pkg23
summary: Fixed findings 4 to 8 and the documentation findings 3 and 9. Backend 738 passed (1 skip), Vitest shared 101 and web 202 passed (2 opt-in skips), Playwright e2e 133 passed with screenshots on. make lint is clean (redocly keeps its 2 existing warnings).

blocks.heading: Findings
rows: #3 ARCHITECTURE.md marks built work as planned
Markers removed for T-002a to T-002l (file map, migrations 0002 to 0006, patterns, personas, sections 9, 9.1, 9.2, 16); operations now '17, all built'. T-002m items stay planned.

ReportUpdate.checklist max_length=100: one 422 entry at body.checklist ('at most 100 items'), response under 2 KB, nothing saved. openapi maxItems: 100, client regenerated (gen:check OK). New API test.
The length rule now sits before the validator, so the message is 'String should have at most 5000 characters' (500 for checklist notes). Asserted in the scenario 9 test.
#6 'Marked as reviewed' after a reopening edit
ReviewPanel drops the done and already-reviewed note when the report goes from reviewed back to awaiting. Vitest case and an e2e step (review, edit, save, expect Awaiting review and no confirmation).

useRefreshReport accepts strict:true so the refetch throws; the form keeps the typed text and the conflict view and shows 'Could not load the latest version. Try again.' Vitest case and an e2e step that aborts the request.

Site address shown in the stacked cell at 768px; stacked cards below 640px (grid per row, Review button at the right). Screenshots retaken at 768 and 360 and inspected: no overflow, address and button visible.
Added to backlog B11: the app role must not own audit_events and must lack TRUNCATE on audit_events, users and job_reports.
